title: Medical Hardship Liability Cap — Household Points for a Documented Tax Household
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), household points are taken off a Riverbend Medical Hardship Assistance award's hardship liability cap percent for the household documented on an accepted federal tax return. Points are taken off the hardship liability cap percent — the percent of the annual household income recorded on the case at which the cap is figured — before the income is scaled at that percent, and the cap percent never goes below zero.

| Household size recorded on the case | Federal tax return accepted on the case | Points taken off |
|---|---|---|
| four or more | yes | 2.0 |
| exactly three | yes | 1.0 |
| two or fewer | yes | none |
| any size | no | none |

**Hypothetical.** A household of five with an accepted federal tax return and a cap percent of 10 percent is figured at 8 percent; the same household without an accepted tax return stays at 10 percent.
